text: In twenty twenty-two, America decided China must not have the chips that build the smartest AI!
Why does a chip matter that much?
Because the best chips train the best AI, for business, and for the military.
So on the seventh of October, twenty twenty-two, Washington blocked Nvidia's top AI chips from China, and the tools to make them.
It built slower versions just for China. The rules tightened. It built another. Then that one needed a licence too.
Nvidia wrote off four and a half billion dollars.
In December twenty twenty-five, Washington allowed H two hundred chips, as long as it got twenty-five percent of the sales.
So, from a ban... to a tax?
Yes. But China barely let them in, and by November twenty twenty-six, Nvidia had stopped shipping them.
Like, follow History Sketches, and tell us what we should map next!
All over who gets to build the smartest AI.
